TITLE: Board View and Tech View – More Actions Menu Has No Unassign Item
TYPE: Story Defect · PARENT: SV-10054 (Keyboard access and focus — design questions to resolve; Ready for QA, read live 16 Oct 2026 — re-read before the ask) · PRIORITY: Medium · LINK: relates to SV-10054
ALREADY REPORTED: none found among SV-11317 to SV-11326, SV-11338, SV-11393 to SV-11398 (titles read live 16 Oct 2026).
SEEN ON: staging build {{v26.40.18-7d85b7d}}, 16 Oct 2026 (run 498, C368152). The same one-item menu was seen on 15 Oct (build v26.40.17-a5c4210, test C368151).
STATUS: DRAFT — NOT FILED. One ask per ticket; the QA lead decides (Rule 62/113).

h2. Description

*The More actions (⋯) menu of a work order that has a lead technician should offer Unassign as a menu item, so the lead can be removed with the keyboard.* On staging the menu offers only "Reassign lead technician".

For example,
* a work order led by a technician shows one item in its More actions menu: "Reassign lead technician"
* there is no "Unassign" item, so the keyboard way to remove the lead goes through the Reassign dialog's Unassigned row instead

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin and check the top bar shows *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab, type a customer whose work order has a lead technician in *Search* (for example {{ZZAUTOTEST F3 Keyboard Reassign}}) and click *Board View*.
# Move focus to that work order's card, press Tab to its *More actions* (⋯) button and press Enter.
#* The menu opens with one item: "Reassign lead technician".
#* There is no "Unassign" item.

*Actual Result:*
* The More actions menu offers only "Reassign lead technician".

*Expected Result:*
* As the test expects: *"Step 10: the menu offers Reassign lead technician and Unassign."* and *"Step 11: {Work-order-3} moves to the Unassigned column and "Lead technician removed" shows."*

{quote}After successful reassignment, show “Lead technician updated”; after unassigning, show “Lead technician removed”.{quote}
